detail: Fatih administration documents 1543–1548 construction, the 18.42 m central dome span, four half-domes and two double-balconied minarets.
Structural field study records the 37 m crown, 41.1 m minarets, 24 drum windows, lead dome coverings and limestone walls.

Primary Aga Khan site catalog records the 42 m hall envelope, open portico, octagonal fountain and named six mausolea. It documents Mehmed’s five-metre octagon, nearby Rüstem octagon and four-metre-square Fatma structure.
Ministry heritage record identifies the southeast tomb cluster and eight-sided Rüstem Paşa tomb.
